headline: Affordable residential district with extensive retail but limited transport and road infrastructure

tags.reason: New flats average 1,600 AZN/m² and courtyard houses 786 AZN/m², driving an affordability index of 71 against the Baku median of 50.
The area supplies 4.78 schools and 3.49 kindergartens per 10,000 residents, outpacing municipal medians of 3.43 and 2.32.

summary: Suraxanı is an outer district where residential property costs are low, shown by an affordability index of 71 and old flat rates of 1,644 AZN/m² against the city median of 2,084 AZN/m². Essential neighbourhood amenities are robust, providing 20.58 groceries and 4.78 schools per 10,000 residents compared to city benchmarks of 13.41 and 3.43. Public transit connectivity is comparatively constrained, reflected in an index score of 32, zero metro stations, and 4.35 bus stops per 10,000 residents versus the 6.22 median. Analysis of 3,044 active listings reveals that 73% possess a title extract (“çıxarış”) and 26% support mortgage financing.
strengths: High concentration of basic educational facilities (4.78 schools and 3.49 kindergartens per 10,000 residents; medians 3.43 and 2.32)
Extensive neighbourhood grocery retail provision (20.58 groceries per 10,000 residents; median 13.41)
Low residential acquisition costs across property types (1,600 AZN/m² for new flats; median 2,295 AZN/m²)
weaknesses: Weak public transit network coverage without direct rapid transit (0 metro stations, nearest metro 4.8 km; transport index 32 versus median 55.5)
Poor recorded road pavement coverage (39.6% paved among known roads; median 83.1%)
Below-median healthcare facility density (0.53 clinics and 1.62 hospitals per 10,000 residents; medians 1.22 and 2.75)
best_for: Buyers seeking lower-cost detached courtyard houses averaging 786 AZN/m²
Families requiring local access to primary and secondary schools (4.78 per 10,000 residents)
watch_out: Commuters dependent on the Baku metro, as the nearest station is 4.8 km away
Secondary street quality, given that 86.6% of road surfaces have undocumented condition and only 39.6% of documented roads are paved
Healthcare access, with only 0.53 clinics per 10,000 residents compared to the 1.22 city median
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap coverage is rated high, though 86.6% of road surfaces lack documented paving types. Flat and house price data are derived from a sample of 3,044 listings, whereas land values (12,000 AZN/sot) represent mock demonstration data and must not be used for evaluation.
